protocol: Within-corpus development using cached trained SRL and dependency inputs. Twenty-four previously reviewed claims received manually specified complete reference readings and development inspection; ambiguous readings and a remaining event-nominal identity requirement are explicit. Twenty fresh IDs were sampled before changes, excluding earlier reviewed/pilot IDs. Compiler and reference hashes were frozen before fresh review and are checked. The same assistant judged original text and both graphs, without media/truth labels or independent human gold. This is not source-disjoint generalization or a corpus semantic accuracy estimate.
